title: GTA 6 Unlocks At Midnight In India
yt_title: GTA 6 Unlocks TONIGHT At 12 AM In India 🔥 #shorts
description:
GTA 6 unlocks in India at 12:00 AM IST on November 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, according to PlayStation Support India and the Xbox India store. Preload is already open.

#GTA6 #GTAVI #GTA6India #Rockstar

lines.text: Indian gamers, GTA 6 unlocks in just a few hours.
At exactly midnight tonight, it goes live in India.
That's on PS5 and Xbox Series X and S.
PlayStation and the Xbox India store both list that same time.
Preload is already open, so download it now.
Then the second the clock hits twelve, you're in Vice City.
Thirteen years of waiting ends tonight.
Are you staying up for midnight?
